import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from griffe.loader import GriffeLoader
from griffe.diff import get_full_diff

# Get git repository root
git_root = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=True
).stdout.strip()

# Create temporary directory for checkout
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
    repo_checkout = Path(tmpdir) / "repo"
    
    # Clone repository to temp location
    subprocess.run(
        ["git", "clone", git_root, str(repo_checkout)],
        check=True,
        capture_output=True
    )
    
    # Load at v1.0.0
    subprocess.run(
        ["git", "checkout", "v1.0.0"],
        cwd=str(repo_checkout),
        check=True,
        capture_output=True
    )
    loader_old = GriffeLoader(search_paths=[str(repo_checkout)])
    old_pkg = loader_old.load("mypkg")
    
    # Load at HEAD
    subprocess.run(
        ["git", "checkout", "HEAD"],
        cwd=str(repo_checkout),
        check=True,
        capture_output=True
    )
    loader_new = GriffeLoader(search_paths=[str(repo_checkout)])
    new_pkg = loader_new.load("mypkg")
    
    # Get full diff and print breakages
    diff = get_full_diff(old_pkg, new_pkg)
    for breakage in diff.breakages:
        print(breakage)
